meta.purpose: Per-chemical / per-CAS SEO pages. Source of truth for build-chemicals.ps1 -> chemical/<slug>.html + chemicals.html index. Pages target high-intent 'surplus [chemical] for sale' + CAS queries; live lots are client-rendered from assets/js/data.js by CAS.
meta.note: priceLow/High/offerCount summarize current seed lots for AggregateOffer schema; regenerate when the catalog changes.

chemicals.name: Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA)
chemicals.desc: A fast-evaporating, water-miscible solvent used across cleaning, coatings, personal care and pharma. Surplus IPA is high-volume and shelf-stable, making it one of the most-traded surplus solvents.

chemicals.name: Acetone
chemicals.desc: A versatile, low-cost ketone solvent for coatings, cleaning and chemical processing. Acetone is shelf-stable and frequently appears as overstock or spot surplus in bulk.

chemicals.name: Toluene
chemicals.desc: An aromatic hydrocarbon solvent widely used in coatings and adhesives. Surplus toluene clears readily into spec-tolerant industrial applications.

chemicals.name: Ethyl Acetate
chemicals.desc: A pleasant-smelling ester solvent for coatings, inks and adhesives. Ethyl acetate is shelf-stable and commonly available as discontinued-SKU or overstock surplus.

chemicals.name: Titanium Dioxide (TiO2)
chemicals.desc: The dominant white pigment in paints and plastics, and 20-30% of a coating's raw-material cost - so surplus or discontinued-grade TiO2 carries the highest savings incentive for formulators.

chemicals.name: Zinc Oxide (USP)
chemicals.desc: A USP-grade metal oxide used in sunscreens, skincare and pharma topicals. Short-dated USP zinc oxide is a classic prime-surplus lot for personal-care and pharma buyers.

chemicals.name: Citric Acid Anhydrous (USP/Food)
chemicals.desc: A food- and USP-grade weak acid used as an acidulant, chelant and pH buffer. Citric acid is highly cross-industry, so surplus lots clear fast across food, cleaning and water treatment.

chemicals.name: Sodium Hydroxide (Caustic Soda)
chemicals.desc: A high-volume commodity base for cleaning, water treatment and processing. Caustic soda is extremely spec-tolerant and price-driven - an ideal surplus commodity.

chemicals.name: Polyethylene Glycol PEG-400
chemicals.desc: A water-soluble polyether used as a humectant, excipient and plasticizer. Industrial-grade and off-spec PEG-400 is a frequent by-product surplus stream.

chemicals.name: Glycerin USP (Kosher)
chemicals.desc: A USP/kosher polyol humectant used across personal care, food and pharma. Glycerin overstock is common and clears into multiple grades-tolerant applications.

chemicals.name: Propylene Glycol (USP/EP)
chemicals.desc: A USP/EP diol used as a humectant, carrier and food/pharma solvent. Propylene glycol is high-volume and frequently available as overstock.

chemicals.name: Calcium Carbonate (Coated)
chemicals.desc: A coated mineral filler for plastics, coatings and sealants. As a high-volume, freight-sensitive commodity, surplus calcium carbonate is bought purely on landed cost.

chemicals.name: Epoxy Resin (Bisphenol-A)
chemicals.desc: A bisphenol-A epoxy resin for coatings, adhesives and composites. Off-spec and formulation-change epoxy lots are a steady surplus stream for industrial coatings.

chemicals.name: Acrylic Resin Emulsion
chemicals.desc: A waterborne acrylic binder for paints and adhesives. Short-dated emulsion is a common coatings surplus lot - usable well within shelf life at a deep discount.

chemicals.name: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (SLES 70%)
applications: primary surfactant in shampoos & body wash
chemicals.desc: The workhorse anionic surfactant in personal care and cleaning. Cosmetic-grade SLES overstock clears quickly to formulators and private-label blenders.

chemicals.name: Cocamidopropyl Betaine (CAPB 30%)
chemicals.desc: An amphoteric co-surfactant that boosts foam and mildness in personal care and cleaning. Short-dated CAPB is a frequent cosmetic-surplus lot.

chemicals.name: Xanthan Gum (Food Grade)
chemicals.desc: A high-value food-grade polysaccharide thickener. Because of its cost per kilo, surplus xanthan gum offers among the biggest savings in the food and personal-care lanes.

chemicals.name: Methylene Blue (ACS Reagent)
chemicals.desc: An ACS-grade dye and reagent used as a stain and indicator. Short-dated reagent-grade lab chemicals like methylene blue are ideal small-pack surplus for labs.
